articles.summary: Industry recognition spans thrills, family experiences and live entertainment, with Six Flags claiming five first-place wins and four of the top four spots for Best New Roller Coaster and Best New Show Six Flags Entertainment Corporation (NYSE:FUN), the largest regional amusement park operator in North America, today announced a standout showing in the 2026 Golden Ticket Awards , earning top honors across numerous categories and reinforcing its position as a global leader in thrills, family entertainment and immersive guest experiences. This year, Six Flags parks and attractions earned 25 top 10 Golden Ticket Award rankings , including five No. 1 honors , and a sweep of the top four positions in the Best New Roller Coaster and Best New Show categories. Falcons Flight at Six Flags Qiddiya City took home two first-place wins for Best New Roller Coaster and Best New Attraction Installation at Amusement Today's 2026 Golden Ticket Awards. (Courtesy of Six Flags) Presented annually by
articles.title: Six Flags Dominates 2026 Golden Ticket Awards With Top Honors for New Attractions, Roller Coasters and Entertainment
